annotations.title: See the products of a number

description: Lists the products of the workspace’s WhatsApp numbers, one page at a time. Each belongs to one number and has its name, photos (the first is the cover), variants with their prices and SKUs, price tiers (a price for a quantity), currency, short description, details, stock, delivery note, tags and the questions and answers the business approved. Read-only.

active.description: true for the products switched on, false for those off.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

q.description: Words; each must start a word of the product’s name, SKU or a tag.

name: list_products
title: See the products of a number
